Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary workload: realtime conversational assistant for patient triage (web + mobile).
- Target throughput: ~150–250 QPS at peak, with burst to ~400 QPS expected during specific events.
- Latency goals: p95 generation latency <= 120 ms for short responses (~64 tokens), p99 < 300 ms when possible.
- Expected daily active users: ~10k, peak concurrency estimate ~1.2k.

Next step we discussed: a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive + SEs) to map those requirements to a Dedicated deployment (GPU footprint, autoscale policy, KV/prefix caching and cost estimates).

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu Feb 19, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu Feb 19, 2:00–3:00pm
- Fri Feb 20, 9:00–10:00am

Please let me know which works (or share a couple slots that work on your side). Would you like to include your SRE/ML infra lead on the call? If so, please CC them so we can bake in latency/egress/security constraints.

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and our capacity template (spreadsheet) — if you can pre-fill the throughput/sequence length distribution and traffic shape, it will speed up the sizing exercise.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_discovery_notes.pdf; redwood_capacity_template.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming details from our side and a couple clarifications:
- Throughput: our current expectation is closer to 200 QPS steady at peak business hours, with spikes to 400 QPS for short bursts (2–5 minutes).
- Typical response length: 40–80 tokens for most flows, ~200 tokens for longer summaries.
- SLA ask: ideally p95 < 120ms, p99 < 400ms; we're flexible if you recommend a sensible tradeoff for cost.
- Data residency: US-only (HIPAA considerations), will need to discuss encryption/KMS briefly.

I can do Thu Feb 19 at 2pm PST. I'll loop in our infra lead — cc'ing Alex (alex.diaz@nimbushealth.com) to the thread. Alex will bring our traffic curves and infra constraints.

Samir
